title: Jump-Stop and Sprint-Stop Combo
description: Players practise both the two-foot jump-stop and the one-two sprint-stop at game speed, learning when each stop fits better.

content.objective: Choose and execute the right stop — two-footed or one-two — under control at speed.
content.setup: Players sprint-dribble from the wing toward the elbow with a ball.
instructions: On the first rep, finish with a two-footed jump-stop, landing both feet at once.
On the second rep, finish with a one-two sprint-stop, feet landing in quick sequence.
Alternate stop types every rep for ten total reps.
Add a pass fake immediately after each stop to check balance.
coachingPoints: Stay low through the stop — standing tall means losing balance.
Keep the ball secure through the stop, not loose in one hand.
Choose the stop before arriving, not as an afterthought.
commonMistakes: Travelling by letting the pivot foot slide after the stop.
Decelerating too early and losing speed before the stop even matters.
Letting the feet settle flat instead of staying on the balls of the feet.
content.safety: Give enough space ahead to decelerate safely at speed.
